caption: The drawing depicts a small, hexagonal, dark green bag with a braided green handle that forms a loop at the top. The bag features an embroidered floral design on its front, with a large central flower. The flower consists of gold and yellow petals, light brown and gold leaves and stems, and accents of red and green on the upper leaves. The edges of the bag are decorated with multicolored dots following the seam line, and there are green tassels attached to either side near the top of the bag. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's name, "Florence Earl," is visible in small letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Purse
